perspective:
Ethan’s available information:

- He is Ethan Mohamud, a plumber, and Gary Guo is his long-time close friend; they met in middle school. Ethan knows Gary is a doctor.
- Ethan noticed Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep.
- Ethan became concerned and invited Gary to a two-day weekend retreat for relaxation and rejuvenation.
- Ethan told Gary that his health is important, that he hated seeing him like this, and that the retreat might give him a new perspective.
- Gary declined at first, saying he appreciated Ethan’s concern but couldn’t go because there was too much to do at the hospital.
- At the retreat, Ethan observed Gary being restless and avoiding discussions about work.
- Ethan suspected Gary’s overworking was about more than professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, saying they had been friends since middle school, that Gary could tell him anything, and that he was there to help, not judge.
- Gary replied that it was complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
- After that, Gary opened up to Ethan about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he was facing.
- Ethan felt relief and empathy, and offered to help Gary find a better balance.
- Ethan suggested prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities so Gary would not have to do everything himself.
- Gary agreed, saying he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary about his progress and challenges.
- Ethan saw Gary making efforts to change and felt hopeful and proud.
- Ethan told Gary he was proud of his progress and that he was available whenever Gary needed to talk.
- Gary told Ethan things were better, thanked him for his help, said he was less overwhelmed, and mentioned having time for a movie the previous weekend.
- After a year, Ethan saw that Gary was capable of managing on his own with a healthier work-life balance. Ethan felt satisfied and happy for him.
- Ethan decided to step back while letting Gary know he was always just a call away if needed.
- Ethan told Gary he knew he had this and to keep up the great work.
- Gary thanked Ethan, said he couldn’t have done it without Ethan’s support, and said he felt more in control now.

Ethan has no access to hidden events, private thoughts, or narrator-only information not expressed to him or observed by him.
